summary: A 266,000 sq ft building (its design-builder gives 264,000) built to consolidate UCSF's global health programs and house approximately 1,500 faculty, staff, fellows and residents, opened for occupancy September 2014 with a ribbon-cutting that October.

milestones.text: Ribbon-cutting celebrates the opening of Mission Hall

costs.what: Design-build contract amount for Mission Hall, as stated on design-builder Rudolph and Sletten's own project page (the developer/contractor's own marketing material, not an independent source) -- likely covers combined design and construction, not broken out separately

facts.value: OpenStreetMap tags this building 500 16th St. An earlier version of this record gave 550 16th St from UCSF's release, which could not be re-checked; WRNS's page gives no street address. Not resolved.
WRNS Studio (architect); Rudolph and Sletten (design-builder); Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture (landscape)
6 levels (OpenStreetMap building:levels tag, height 26 m); no architect, owner or contractor source read gives a story count

Global health programs' faculty, staff and students (UCSF history) and faculty providing clinical care, about 1,500 people (Rudolph and Sletten); the Office of the Chancellor is not named in any source read

open_questions: Street address is inconsistent: this record's map shape carries OpenStreetMap's own 500 16th St tag, but an earlier version of this record gave 550 16th St from UCSF's press release, which could not be re-checked; the architect's page gives no street address. Not resolved; both this record and its map notes flag it rather than silently picking one.
No openly licensed image was found; none is hosted here.

Images: no plan drawing, elevation or openly-licensed photograph was found for this building specifically. Searched: UCSF Real Estate's Mission Bay campus-site and LRDP pages (realestate.ucsf.edu, which could not be checked); the UCSF 2014 LRDP EIR's CEQAnet filing (SCH 2013092047, whose pre-2016 attachments aren't hosted on CEQAnet itself); a May 2000 Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings design-approval item for an early Mission Bay building (text-only, no figures); the 2008 "UCSF Mission Bay Planning Principles" appendix (a citywide-scale community map, no individual buildings labeled); and a UCSF wayfinding campus map (not an adopted plan, EIR or permit filing, so not eligible as public-record even though found). Not pursued further; the record's own project sources above remain the citation for the building's history.

As of 2026-09-29, UCSF's 2014 news page (source of the September 2014 occupancy and October 2014 ribbon-cutting) could not be re-checked; WRNS and Rudolph and Sletten confirm a 2014 completion only. No readable source gives a story count (OpenStreetMap: 6 levels) or names the Office of the Chancellor as an occupant, so 'seven-story' and the Chancellor were removed.
